source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the nuclear reactor and nuclear waste (PDF 143-145, printed 139-141).

blocks.text: Nuclear power station (bijli ghar) mein reactor wahi kaam karta hai jo thermal power station mein furnace (bhatti) karti hai. Bhatti mein koyla ya tel jala kar heat (hararat) banti hai, jab ke reactor mein fission reaction heat paida karta hai. Jab uranium ya kisi aur bhari atom ka fission hota hai to har nucleus se taqreeban 200 MeV energy nikalti hai. Yeh energy fission fragments (tukdon) ki kinetic energy ki shakal mein hoti hai. Yeh tez tukde aapas mein aur uranium atoms se takrate hain, aur is tarah un ki kinetic energy heat ban jati hai. Is heat se steam (bhaap) banti hai jo turbine ghumati hai; turbine generator ghumata hai jo bijli banata hai. Nuclear power station ka sketch (khaaka) Fig. 19.5 mein hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Ek induced (bahar se karwaya gaya) nuclear reaction jis mein ²³⁸₉₂U transuranium element plutonium ²³⁹₉₄Pu mein badal (transmute ho) jata hai.

blocks.alt: Neutron (1-0-n) plus 238-92-U se 239-92-U plus gamma banta hai. 23.5 minute baad 239-92-U, 239-93-Np plus electron (0-(-1)-e) plus gamma banta hai. 2.4 din baad 239-93-Np, 239-94-Pu plus electron plus gamma banta hai.
blocks.caption: Kya aap jante hain? box: induced nuclear reaction jis mein 238-92-U transuranium element plutonium 239-94-Pu mein badal jata hai (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: U-238 aik neutron absorb (jazb) kar ke U-239 banta hai. Phir do beta decay hote hain: har aik mein aik electron (0-(-1)-e) nikalta hai, is liye Z 92 se 93 (Np) aur phir 94 (Pu) ho jata hai jab ke A 239 hi rehta hai. Kitab ka text 'transmitted' likhti hai; sahi lafz 'transmuted' (aik element ka doosre mein badalna) hai.

blocks.alt: Concrete shield (hifazati deewar) ke andar: steel ka pressure vessel jis mein laal (red) fuel elements, kaali control rods aur bohat pressure wala pani hai. Garam pani vessel ke oopar daen se pressurizer ke paas se heat exchanger jata, us ke coiled (ghoomdaar) pipe se neeche aata aur pump se wapas vessel mein jata hai (hare teer). Heat exchanger se do pipe shield se bahar jate hain: oopar wala bahar (laal teer), neeche wala andar (neela teer).
blocks.caption: Figure 19.5: nuclear power station (bijli ghar) (kitab ki Figure 19.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Reactor ka garam pani (bohat zyada pressure par, taake ubal na sake) oopar wale pipe se heat exchanger jata, wahan doosre pipe ke pani ko bhaap banata aur pump se wapas reactor mein aata hai (hare teer). Daen taraf laal teer bhaap ko turbine ki taraf le jata aur neela teer thanda pani wapas lata hai; turbine aur generator is figure mein nahi dikhaye gaye. Pressurizer pressure ko barabar (constant) rakhta hai. Kitab 'Pressurize' likhti hai; sahi lafz 'Pressurizer' hai.
Reactor ke aam taur par yeh ahem hisse hain:

items: Core: reactor ka sab se ahem hissa. Yahan fuel (eendhan) cylinder jaisi tubes mein rakha jata hai. Fuel kai qisam ke hain. Shuru ke reactors mein uranium fuel tha; is mein uranium-235 ki quantity (miqdar) 2.4 se 3.0 percent tak barhai (enrich ki) jati hai, kyunke natural (qudrati) uranium mein uranium-235 sirf 0.7 percent hota hai. Aaj kal plutonium-239 aur uranium-233 bhi fuel ke taur par istemal hote hain.

Moderator: fuel rods kam atomic weight wale material (maddah), jaise pani ya heavy water (bhari pani), mein rakhi jati hain. Moderator ka kaam fission se nikalne wale neutrons ki speed kam karna aur unhein fuel ki taraf bhejna hai. Heavy water aam hydrogen ¹₁H ki jagah hydrogen ke bhari isotope ²₁H (deuterium) se banta hai. Fission ke neutrons bohat tez hote hain aur ²³⁵₉₂U ya ²³⁹₉₄Pu jaise fuel mein fission ke liye theek (suitable) nahi; is kaam ke liye slow neutrons behtar hain. Isi liye moderators istemal hote hain.

Control rods: moderator ke ilawa neutrons ka number control karne ka intezam hota hai, taake har fission ke neutrons mein se sirf ek agla fission kare. Is ke liye cadmium ya boron ki rods istemal hoti hain, jo slow (thermal) neutrons ko bohat zyada absorb (jazb) karti hain. Yeh rods core mein andar ya bahar ki jati hain taake agla fission karne wale neutrons control hon; is tarah chain reaction ki speed control mein rehti hai. Emergency ya repair (marammat) ke waqt rods ko reactor mein gira diya jata hai, chain reaction ruk jata hai aur reactor band ho jata hai.

Heat exchanger aur coolant: core mein chain reaction se heat banti hai aur core ka temperature taqreeban 500 °C tak pohanchta hai. Yeh heat bohat zyada pressure wale pani, heavy water ya kisi aur liquid ke zariye heat exchanger tak le jayi jati hai. Wahan is heat se aam pani ki garam steam banti hai, jo turbine chalati hai, aur turbine generator ghuma kar bijli banata hai. Turbine se nikalne wali steam ka temperature taqreeban 300 °C hota hai; ise thanda kar ke dobara pani banaya jata hai, aur is ke liye aam taur par darya ya samandar ka pani istemal hota hai. Karachi nuclear power plant (KANUPP) mein heavy water moderator bhi hai aur core se heat exchanger tak heat bhi le jata hai, jab ke turbine ki steam samandar ke pani se thandi ki jati hai.

Pakistan ke plants: Chashma (Mianwali) mein chaar units, C-1 se C-4, pressurized water reactors (PWR) hain jo darya Sindh (Indus) ke pani se thande hote hain. Karachi mein K-2 aur K-3 (PWR, har ek taqreeban 1100 MW) chal rahe hain jo samandar (Arabian Sea) ke pani se thande hote hain; KANUPP-1 2021 mein band ho gaya. Kul capacity (gunjaish) 3000 MW se zyada hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein teen ghaltiyan hain. (1) Point 1 aur 2 mein isotope ka naam chhapne se reh gaya hai: enrich hone wala aur natural uranium mein 0.7 percent wala isotope uranium-235 (²³⁵₉₂U) hai. (2) Kitab kehti hai ke cadmium aur boron 'tez (fast)' neutrons absorb karte hain; asal mein yeh slow (thermal) neutrons ko zyada absorb karte hain, aur control rods tak pohanchne wale neutrons moderator se pehle hi dheeme ho chuke hote hain. (3) Kitab kehti hai ke Karachi mein teen plants chal rahe hain aur sab PWR hain jo darya Sindh se thande hote hain. KANUPP-1 2021 mein band ho chuka; Karachi ke K-2 aur K-3 PWR hain magar samandar ke pani se thande hote hain; sirf Chashma ke chaar PWR darya Sindh se thande hote hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Radiation ka trefoil symbol (teen pattiyon wala nishan) poori duniya mein un jagahon ko batane ke liye lagaya jata hai jahan radioactivity istemal ho rahi ho ya artificial (insan ki banayi hui) radiation paida ki ja rahi ho.

blocks.alt: Gehre grey rang mein radiation ka trefoil symbol: beech mein chhota gol nishan aur us ke gird teen pattiyan, aik neeche ki taraf aur do oopar baen aur daen ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Kya aap jante hain?: radiation ka symbol (kitab ke box ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Beech ka gol nishan radioactive source hai aur teen pattiyan us se har taraf nikalne wali radiation dikhati hain. Jahan yeh nishan laga ho wahan radioactivity istemal ho rahi hai, is liye wahan bina ijazat aur hifazat ke na jayein.

Reactor mein dala gaya nuclear fuel use kuch mahine chalata hai. Phir fissile material kam hone lagta hai, to used (istemal ho chuka) fuel nikal kar naya fuel dala jata hai. Used fuel mein ab bhi bohat tez radioactive materials hote hain jin ki half-life hazaron saal hai. In ki radiation aur particles living things (jandaron) ke liye bohat harmful (nuqsan wale) hain. Afsos ke nuclear waste (kachre) ko thikane lagane (disposal) ka koi poora intezam nahi. Ise samandar mein nahi phenka ja sakta, na aisi jagah chhoda ja sakta hai jahan yeh mitti ya hawa ke zariye environment (mahol) ko pollute (ganda) kare; peene ke pani mein to bilkul nahi jana chahiye. Ab tak ki behtareen jagah purani salt mines (namak ki kaanon) ki tah hai, jo bohat dry (khushk) aur zameen se hazaron metre neeche hain. Wahan yeh kachra zameen ki surface (satah) ke environment ko pollute kiye baghair decay hota rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Radioactive waste teen qisam ka hota hai: high level, medium level aur low level. Yeh sab ground water (zameen ke neeche ka pani) aur zameen ke environment ke liye khatarnak hain.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Lambi half-life ki wajah se radioactive waste ko safe (mehfooz) tareeqe se dispose karna (thikane lagana) bohat mushkil hai. Maslan plutonium (Pu) ki half-life 24,000 saal hai, is liye yeh taqreeban 1,82,000 saal tak khatarnak rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Zyada tar reactors mein istemal se pehle uranium fuel ko enrich kyun karna parta hai?
blocks.explanation: Natural uranium mein fission karne wala uranium-235 sirf taqreeban 0.7 percent hai. Aam pani wale moderator ke saath itna kam U-235 chain reaction jari nahi rakh sakta, is liye U-235 ka hissa taqreeban 2.4 se 3 percent tak barhaya jata hai.

items: Reactor furnace ki jagah fission se heat deta hai: heat → steam → turbine → generator.
Hisse: core (fuel rods), moderator (neutrons dheeme), control rods (neutrons absorb), coolant aur heat exchanger.
Enriched fuel (2.4-3 percent U-235); lambi half-life wale waste ko safe (mehfooz) jagah chahiye.
